name: cache-keeper
description: Keeps an idle session's prompt cache warm with a cache-served fork just before the TTL lapses, within limits you set.

enabled.title: Keep caches warm
enabled.description: Ping idle sessions before their prompt cache expires. /keepwarm on|off overrides per session.

ttlMinutes.title: Cache TTL (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: Prompt-cache lifetime of the main conversation: 60 on a subscription within plan usage.

leadMinutes.title: Ping lead (minutes)
leadMinutes.description: How long before the cache would expire to ping.

maxPings.title: Max pings per idle stretch
maxPings.description: Stop after this many automatic pings since your last real turn (manual /keepwarm now pings do not count). Pinging also stops at noon the next day (Mon-Thu) or 17:00 on Friday, and never starts after Friday 17:00 or at the weekend; /keepwarm for|until overrides both.

minContextTokens.title: Minimum context (tokens)
minContextTokens.description: Skip sessions whose context is smaller than this; they are cheap to re-cache.
